method: Post-hoc independent local review of the new prototype, before any model campaign. Twelve constructed supported fixtures compare the source AST interpreter and real Z3 against transpiled JavaScript on every finite input. Four adversarial shape/assertion cases must remain unknown. Initial adverse observations preceded hardening and were not byte-bound replays; post-hardening controls bind the exact source contents below. This is no global success/efficiency claim.

analysis.scope: Only the selected scalar function body and supplied bounded integer/boolean inputs are modeled. Integers and every arithmetic intermediate stay within JavaScript's safe integer range. Calls, loops, mutation, globals, floats, NaN and Infinity are unsupported. A bounded result does not establish repository correctness, executed tests, source admission or user acceptance.
analysis.reason: No violating input exists in the supplied finite safe integer/boolean domain under the supported isolated-function semantics.
